elements.description:
The notification center: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications grouped by day, with
tabs, read state, inline actions, dismiss, Mark all as read and Load more.

properties.name: items
properties.description: The notifications, in any order – the panel sorts them newest first and groups them by day

properties.name: categories
properties.description: App-defined tabs after All and Unread; a notification shows under the one its `category` names

properties.name: filter
properties.description: The tab showing: "all", "unread" or a category's id

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the bell's panel is open

properties.name: inline
properties.description: Renders the panel on its own, as a card, without the bell – for a notifications page or a side drawer

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The panel's title, and the start of the bell's name

properties.name: unreadCount
properties.description: The badge's count when the app knows more unread than it has loaded; unset counts the unread `items`

properties.name: max
properties.description: The badge shows "<max>+" above this (default 9)

properties.name: dot
properties.description: The badge is a dot, without the count (the bell's name still says how many)

properties.name: pulse
properties.description: The badge pulses briefly when new notifications arrive (not with reduced motion)

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description: Every notification gets a dismiss button, not only those with `dismissible`

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Shows the skeleton in place of the list – the first page is loading

properties.name: loadingMore
properties.description: Shows "Loading more…" at the end of the list – a further page is loading

properties.name: hasMore
properties.description: There are older notifications to load: shows Load more (or, with `infinite`, loads as the end scrolls into view)

properties.name: infinite
properties.description: Fires tc-load-more when the end of the list scrolls into view, instead of showing Load more

properties.name: error
properties.description: An error to show with Try again – in place of the list when nothing is loaded, else at its end

properties.name: settingsHref
properties.description: A settings link in the header (an icon button named “Notification settings”)

properties.name: settings
properties.description: A settings button in the header that fires tc-settings, when there's no `settingsHref`

properties.name: now
properties.description: "Now" for the day groups and relative times (epoch ms or a Date). Unset: the time the element connected

properties.name: locale
properties.description: The locale for dates and weekdays; unset uses the browser's

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Any of the panel's texts, to change the wording or the language

properties.name: announce
properties.description: What's announced when notifications arrive; default “New notification: <actor> <title>” or “3 new notifications”

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-read-change
events.description: A notification was opened (marking it read) or its read toggle was used; detail `{ ids, read, items }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app changes it

events.name: tc-mark-all-read
events.description: Mark all as read was chosen; detail `{ ids, items }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app marks them

events.name: tc-dismiss
events.description: A notification's dismiss button was used; detail `{ id, item, items }` (`items` without it). Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app removes it

events.name: tc-action
events.description: An inline action was chosen; detail `{ id, action, item }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the notification unread

events.name: tc-item-open
events.description: A notification was opened (clicked, or Enter on it); detail `{ id, item }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops its link being followed (route it yourself)

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: A tab was picked; detail `{ filter }` – "all", "unread" or a category's id. Cancelable: preventDefault() and the app sets `filter`

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The panel is opening or closing; detail `{ open }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps it as it is

events.name: tc-load-more
events.description: Load more was chosen, or the end of the list scrolled into view with `infinite`; detail `{ after, count }`. Cancelable: preventDefault() and the element doesn't set `loadingMore` itself

events.name: tc-retry
events.description: Try again was chosen after an error; detail `{}`. Cancelable: preventDefault() and the element doesn't clear `error` and show loading itself

events.name: tc-settings
events.description: The settings link or button was chosen; detail `{}`. Cancelable: preventDefault() stops `settingsHref` being followed

functions.name: notificationMs
functions.description: A notification's time in epoch ms (NaN when it can't be read)

functions.name: notificationTime
functions.signature: notificationTime(ms: number, now: number, locale?: string, justNow: unknown): string
functions.description: The compact relative time: "now", "5m", "3h", "2d", then the date ("12 Oct")

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's title, and the start of the bell's name – "Notifications" by default

props.name: items
props.description: The notifications. Controlled when defined: reading, Mark all as read and dismiss only report, and you update the list

props.name: defaultItems
props.description: The notifications when uncontrolled – the component applies read changes and dismissals itself

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Called with the list as it is after a read change, Mark all as read or a dismissal, and what happened

props.name: onReadChange
props.description: Notifications were marked read or unread (opening one marks it read)

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Mark all as read was chosen, with the ids it marks

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: A notification was dismissed

props.name: onAction
props.description: An inline action was chosen; return false to keep the notification unread

props.name: onItemOpen
props.description: A notification was opened; return false to stop its link being followed (route it yourself)

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: The next page is wanted: the oldest loaded notification's id and how many are loaded. Set `loadingMore` while it loads

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Try again was chosen after an error

props.name: onSettings
props.description: The settings link or button was chosen; return false to stop `settingsHref` being followed

props.name: filter
props.description: The tab showing: "all", "unread" or a category's id. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The tab showing first when uncontrolled

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: A tab was picked

props.name: open

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the panel starts open when uncontrolled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The panel opened or closed

changelog: **`tc-notifications`:** the notification center. - **Bell:** an unread badge. - **List:** All / Unread and category tabs, with items grouped by day. - **Per item:** read toggle, actions and dismiss; "Mark all as read". - **More:** load more or infinite scroll, polite announcements of new arrivals, and an inline mode. Every change is a cancelable event.

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: Popover API
features.without: Lists open fixed to the window instead of in the top layer, so a clipping ancestor or a modal can cover them.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
